wiki.content: "Don't Stop 'Til You Get Enough" is a song by American singer-songwriter Michael Jackson. Written by Jackson, it was released by Epic Records on July 10, 1979, as the first track on his fifth studio album, "Off the Wall" (1979). The song marked Jackson's first solo recording in which he had significant creative control. It was Jackson's second solo single to reach number one on the US Billboard Hot 100 chart, following "Ben", and his first solo number-one on the Billboard Soul Singles chart, where it remained at the top for six weeks. The song has been certified 5× Platinum by the Recording Industry Association of America (RIAA) and also reached number one in nine other countries. It received positive reviews from contemporary music critics and is considered one of the prominent disco songs of its era. The music video for "Don't Stop 'Til You Get Enough", directed by Nick Saxton and released in October 1979, features Jackson dancing and appearing in triplicate against different colored backgrounds. The song earned Jackson his first Grammy Award and American Music Awards.
